To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the evaluation methods are different, (2) the best method for evaluating ANN performance is to use a holdout set, (3) the best evaluation method for evaluating the performance of other ML methods is to use a validation set, and (4) a systematic evaluation procedure should be followed to ensure a fair evaluation.

(1) the most appropriate evaluation methods are cross-validation and bootstrapping, (2) cross-validation is preferable to bootstrapping when the sample size is large enough and the data set is not too small, and (3) the systematic evaluation procedure for evaluating ML models in engineering problems includes: (a) defining a clear problem statement, (b) collecting and preparing the data set, (c) selecting the ML model, (d) evaluating and comparing ML models, (e)
(1) evaluation is important and (2) the evaluation procedure should include the use of several evaluation methods, each of which is suitable to a specific evaluation goal.
